title: VYBE 0.14.0 - Instant Playback and Immersive Artwork
notes:
PLAYBACK
• Tapping a song starts audio in about one second, cold start included, by racing the preferred stream resolver against its fallbacks concurrently.
• All resolvers share a single-flight cache, so a track is never resolved twice and the tapped song keeps a free connection.
• The liveness probe now sends exactly what the player sends, so dead mirrors lose the race instead of winning and then failing with HTTP 403.
• Repeated 403 recovery loops that stalled playback after the first buffering pass are gone.

RECOMMENDATIONS
• No random songs. Discovery no longer samples random seeds from your history, Explore no longer reshuffles its chips daily, and Home no longer repeats shuffled filler rows.
• The same recording published under several video ids is collapsed to a single card, so the grid never shows a duplicate song.
• Provider ordering is authoritative and results are never re-ranked by title text.
• Opening VYBE never starts playback on its own, so nothing is written to your YouTube Music history without a tap.

LOOK AND FEEL
• Full App artwork: one app-wide blurred cover behind every screen, bar and sheet, with a toggle in Settings.
• Consistent Energize and Romance labels.

PACKAGE
• One signed universal APK for Android 8.0+ (ARM64, ARMv7, x86, x86_64). R8-minified and resource-shrunk.
